prompt: Multi-word search values are no longer quoted in the queries gh sends to GitHub. For example, `gh search issues --label "help wanted"` now produces `label:help wanted`, so "wanted" is treated as a stray keyword and results are wrong; multi-word phrase keywords like `gh search repos "hello world"` are broken the same way across all the search commands. Values containing spaces used to be wrapped in double quotes automatically. Restore that.
